name: University of Plymouth

sources.title: UKVI credibility interviews - University of Plymouth
topics: What motivated you to choose the UK as your study destination?
Why did you choose this course?
How well do you understand your course?
How are you funding your studies?
quotes: What differences did you consider between studying in the UK and studying in your home country or another country?
What made University of Plymouth stand out compared to other UK universities?
What are your personal reasons for choosing this specific course?
What do you know about the structure of your course?
How do you plan to pay for your tuition fees and living expenses?
What do you plan to do after completing your course?
In what ways do you think this course will help you achieve your long-term ambitions?
How did you decide that this course at University of Plymouth was the right fit for you?
sources.notes: Conducted by a UK Entry Clearance Officer (UKVI), in person / telephone / video call. Attendance mandatory; non-attendance = automatic refusal. 'the ECO can refuse your application if they are not convinced that you are a genuine student'. Last two quotes were read in the search-result snippet for this same URL (fetch summary omitted them).

sources.title: Credibility Interviews for Tier 4 Students - Plymouth University
